title: Which geometric methods survive decoherence? A pre-registered comparison of 23 methods on simulated NV-diamond thermometry
description: Pre-registered experiment comparing 23 geometric methods and 7 scalar baselines across five decoherence axes in simulated NV-diamond intracellular thermometry. Contains analysis code, pre-registration (frozen under commit SHA 8401d54), deviation log, and raw results (150,000 method evaluations, 100 seeds, bootstrap CIs). The central finding is a method-axis sensitivity map: no single geometric method generalizes across all decoherence types, and device calibration variation (the simplest noise mechanism) is the axis that discriminates between methods.
notes: Pre-registration frozen under commit SHA 8401d54. All results are fully deterministic and reproducible from the frozen commit and seed pool (seeds 1000-1099).
